status: Owner requirements captured; architecture synthesized; implementation and proof pending

overrides.requirement: A generated world supports a polished 60–80-hour adventure for players pursuing that path, with bonus chapters, areas and paths; this is a quality target, not a compulsory main plot or a reason to prevent autonomous NPC outcomes.
overrides.status: Earlier target retained and reconciled with owner agency direction

overrides.requirement: Approximately twice the baseline adventure horizon remains a stretch opportunity; the world continues through and beyond individual campaigns, careers and independently resolved crises.
overrides.status: Earlier stretch target retained; no forced campaign completion

overrides.requirement: Provide Dungeons & Dragons and Final Fantasy-inspired breadth through coherent original stats, skills, classes/jobs, conditions, items, magic, exploration, social action and resource mechanics; maintain an explicit capability inventory rather than claiming every rule from every edition.
overrides.status: Owner breadth requirement clarified; detailed numeric rules remain to be specified

additions.requirement: Build fully customizable persistent transport assemblies for ships, boats, canoes, carriages, chariots, dwarven tanks, sandships, tunneling ships, air balloons and airships; connect parts, crafting, cargo, crew, wear, maintenance, enhancement and travel-domain constraints.
Support player and NPC alliances, friendships, rivalries and other directed relations, party formation and shared combat, exploration, skill, power and work synergies with real obligations and costs.
Seed cosmic magical, crystal and elemental influences on species and subspecies; model eon-scale ancestry, convergence, divergence and historical change with persistent causal provenance.

Keep species tendencies, culture, civilization, worship, alignment and individual traits distinct but interacting; permit exceptional births and individual learning, choices and transformations beyond species norms.

Provide deep interconnected crafting, herbalism, cooking and alchemical process graphs with knowledge, ingredients, substitutions, tools, stages, quality, byproducts, labor, experimentation and accountable resource use.

Support overt/covert factions, secret alliances, trade networks, guilds, nations, institutions and political relationships whose actual actions alter world events, NPC lives and opportunities; keep secrets knowledge-scoped.

Allow contingent world crises and dark-lord roles that may never arise or may be resolved by NPCs or other players; support adventure, ordinary careers, allegiance, antagonist recruitment where justified, conquest, captivity and playable continuations without a compulsory chosen protagonist.

Every individual NPC has player-equivalent depth through the same applicable character model, capabilities, progression, inventory, action rules, relationships and persistent history. Different control or simulation frequency must not create a shallow alternate NPC model.

NPCs continuously participate in world causality: perceived events and scoped knowledge affect needs, commitments, decisions and feasible actions, which create further consequences and persistent memories in detailed and distant simulation.

Support fantastical mounts including horse, lizard and bird types, pets and familiars as persistent actors; integrate anatomy, training, bonds, load, equipment, feeding, care, health, upkeep, delegation and abilities across travel, exploration and combat.

Provide magic specializations such as illusion and invocation, elemental/other facet combinations, researched and crafted spells, weapon/object enhancement, spellbinding and lingering area/object/person effects through a shared typed, versioned effect and research system.

Represent gods and deities as first-class cosmological entities with identities, domains, powers/limits, motives, relationships, worshippers, institutions and consequential interventions through the authoritative simulation.

Support classes/jobs and their specializations as first-class shared player/NPC progression definitions, preserving original classes/abilities and allowing explicitly governed combinations, training, proficiencies and retained learning.
